svg.text: How a change moves through the kit, as of v2.8. The purple arrow goes back to Build; dashed arrows skip a stage with the owner's no-spec label; the green loop tests the harness itself.
Owner approves or asks for changes
Bug fix: failing test committed first,
PR from the template: spec, verdict,
Deploys in the PR's Deploy order
Labels only the owner adds: no-spec,
Change name and diff only, never the
UI mock-up rendered with the app's
Bug fix: test fails first, for the bug's
Verifier: every scenario has a test or
code, every task is done, design
desktop and phone; verifier uses them
Owner approves the plan and the
Git hooks: no commits to main
Before gh pr create: spec check and
pre-push hook: no pushes to main
Deny rules: agents can't merge or
↺ FAIL verdict on [4. Check] or [5. PR and review] loops back to [3. Build]; with new commits on the same branch
↻ Harness evals: when AGENTS.md, skills, hooks, agents or check scripts change
1. Owner runs scripts/eval-run.sh: the smoke set (~5 tasks), or all tasks for a baseline
2. Real tasks from the repo (remove, replay, bugfix) go through stages 1 to 6 in a throwaway copy
3. Scored on 6 checks: committed, unit, spec, mutation, format, hidden answer-key tests
4. Compared with the last run at the same agent, model and effort: keep or revert the change
